description: Runs a Google Local (`tbm=lcl`) search for `keyword` and returns up to ~20 businesses as JSON: `name`, `rating`, `reviews`, `price`, `category`, `address`, `phone`, `website`, `hours`, and a top `review_snippet`. `phone` and `website` are null when Google does not render them for that result - service businesses (plumbers, contractors) almost always carry both. Local results are location-sensitive - set `proxy_country` (and optionally `gl`/`hl`) to target a market. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

gl.description: Google country of search, ISO-2 lowercase, e.g. 'us', 'de'.

hl.description: Google UI language, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr'. Default: en.

keyword.description: Search phrase, e.g. 'coffee shops in chicago' or 'plumbers near SW1A'.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'GB'). Local results are location-sensitive, so pick the country you want results for.

name: google_local
title: Scrape Google Local business listings
